phase: Phase R2 Task 3 — Accounts unaudited-route security matrix independent review
summary: The exact Accounts denominator is 17 routes, all 17 route anchors and source/test catalog digests replay against the accepted frozen archive, all 102 required security dimensions are present, and the matrix honestly remains candidate-only with five declared audit gaps and two failed FR4 gates. Acceptance is nevertheless denied by four High evidence/contract findings: coherent false-green gate results and arbitrary gate ownership are accepted without immutable command receipts; route/dimension evidence associations are semantically unconstrained and permit audit-gap laundering; claims of immutable audit behavior do not cite the frozen database immutability control or its executable test; and the destructive OIDC logout boundary is marked validated despite having no Zod contract. Under AGENTS.md and the audit protocol, ACCOUNTS-AUDIT-001, -003, -004, and -005 are genuine blockers; ACCOUNTS-AUDIT-002 may be explicitly non-applicable only with an accurate source assertion explaining authenticated introspection and its session-idle refresh. Zero-Critical/High policy therefore requires FAIL.
blocking_findings: [high][R2-T3-H1] FR4 gate outcomes and ownership are unbound claims rather than independently replayable evidence. matrix.json:66-73 records only command tokens, exitCode, result, and a free-form owner; it records no audited commit/source-state identity, execution time, stdout/stderr digest, or immutable result artifact. _validate_gates at measure/tests/test_business_operations_graph_baseline_r2_accounts.py:388-418 checks only that result agrees with exitCode, owner is a non-empty string, and the aggregate disposition agrees with the four claimed exits. An independent coherent adversary changed every exit to 0, every result to PASS, every owner to unverified, and the disposition to ALL_REQUIRED_GATES_PASSED; _validate_matrix accepted it and printed COHERENT_FALSE_GREEN_ACCEPTED. Current reruns reproduce the recorded Accounts-test and backend-typecheck failures, but the recorded backend-test PASS did not reproduce in two full reruns even though the audited Accounts/backend/Codecamp paths are unchanged from 47d060202. Exact remediation: retain hash-bound per-command receipts containing source/worktree identity, command argv, exit, stdout/stderr bytes or digests, and an enumerated owning track/package; validate every reference and add coherent false-green, missing-receipt, changed-source, and owner-substitution adversaries.

[high][R2-T3-H2] The fail-closed validator proves that cited assertion/test IDs exist but never proves that an ID is relevant to a specific route and dimension. _validate_dispositions at measure/tests/test_business_operations_graph_baseline_r2_accounts.py:342-385 accepts any catalog assertion or test for any route/dimension, and its audit protection depends only on an assertion ID ending in '-no-audit'. An independent adversary changed GET /api/oidc/authorize's blocking audit disposition to NOT_APPLICABLE, replaced its evidence with the unrelated health assertion/test, removed ACCOUNTS-AUDIT-001, and _validate_matrix accepted it as SEMANTIC_AUDIT_LAUNDERING_ACCEPTED. The committed negative test only launders acceptance while retaining service-authorize-no-audit, so it misses this bypass. This violates FR4.2-FR4.3 because the 97 EVIDENCED_CANDIDATE dispositions are not fail-closed semantic mappings. Exact remediation: freeze an allowed route-plus-dimension-to-assertion/test mapping or validate independently signed per-disposition source assertions; add cross-route, cross-dimension, unrelated-N/A, and finding-removal adversaries for every blocking class.

[high][R2-T3-H3] Immutable-audit dispositions are not evidenced as immutable. The management routes cite identity-kernel/capabilities-policy/service-management, which prove required append calls and descriptor metadata, while session login cites service-login, which proves appendAudit calls; none cites the frozen database trigger or an executable immutability test. The actual control lives in packages/db/company-identity/drizzle/0001_immutable_identity_audit.sql and packages/db/src/company-identity/__tests__/privileges-audit.integration.test.ts, outside assertionCatalog/testCatalog. A descriptor containing immutable: true and an INSERT helper do not establish AGENTS.md's append-only guarantee. This leaves the audit dimension incomplete for routes currently labeled IMMUTABLE_CAPABILITY_AUDIT_REQUIRED or LOGIN_SUCCESS_AND_DENIAL_AUDITED_BY_SERVICE and violates FR4.2-FR4.3. Exact remediation: add frozen source anchors for the company_identity_audit_events mutation-rejection trigger and hash-bound executable immutability coverage, then associate them with every disposition claiming immutable persistence.

[high][R2-T3-H4] POST /api/oidc/logout is a destructive external boundary but its validation disposition is incorrectly accepted. apps/accounts/app/api/oidc/logout/route.ts:6-14 only checks startsWith("Bearer ") and passes the remainder directly to service.localLogout; packages/backend/src/modules/company-identity/service.ts:411-413 ultimately hashes any remainder, including an empty or malformed token. matrix.json:134 labels this BEARER_SCHEME_BOUNDARY_CHECK with EVIDENCED_CANDIDATE, but AGENTS.md requires Zod runtime validation at every external Route Handler boundary and FR4.3 explicitly says an unvalidated boundary blocks acceptance. Exact remediation: validate a strict non-empty bearer/session-token schema at the transport or domain boundary, add malformed/empty/oversized-token route tests, and keep this validation disposition BLOCKING_GAP until that frozen evidence exists.
nonblocking_findings: [medium][R2-T3-M1] ACCOUNTS-AUDIT-002 is overclassified as a mandatory audit blocker. Token introspection is a confidential-client-authenticated status read, not login, logout, password change, permission change, billing, or a destructive action under AGENTS.md and audit-protocol rule 9.4. Its repository implementation does refresh SSO last_seen_at/idle_expires_at, so a valid N/A must disclose that operational session-idle mutation rather than call the operation a pure read. ACCOUNTS-AUDIT-001 remains genuinely blocking because it issues a one-time authorization credential; -003 and -005 are explicit destructive logout/session-revocation events; and -004 consumes an authorization code and creates an application session, the application-login/session-issuance equivalent. Replace only -002 with an explicitly reviewed N/A assertion if the owner accepts that policy interpretation; do not waive -001/-003/-004/-005.

test_strategy_violations: Gate tests cover only self-consistency of claimed exits; they do not consume immutable command receipts or reject coherent false-green outcomes and owner substitution.
Disposition tests validate catalog membership but not route/dimension relevance; an unrelated health assertion can replace a security-sensitive audit finding and remain Green.
No test binds immutable-audit claims to the database trigger or its mutation-rejection coverage.
No route test rejects empty, malformed, or oversized bearer values at POST /api/oidc/logout.
live_contract_violations: FR4.2-FR4.3 immutable-audit evidence is incomplete because append calls and descriptor metadata are cited without the database immutability control.
FR4.3 fail-closed evidence mapping is violated because arbitrary cross-route/cross-dimension assertions can support an EVIDENCED_CANDIDATE disposition.
FR4.3 and AGENTS.md external-boundary validation are violated by the accepted manual-only bearer check on the destructive local logout route.
FR4 focused-gate evidence is not independently verifiable or source-bound, and the backend test PASS was not reproducible; failed gates continue to block acceptance.
